fengling-mountain.name: Fengling Mountain Chest
fengling-mountain.description: Find the chest near the Fengling Mountain, at the outskirts of the Xing Dou Forest along the road to Suotuo.

forest-perimeter-1.name: Forest Perimeter Chest One
forest-perimeter-1.description: Find the chest near the central area of the forest outskirts, along the paths of the divine trial and teleport points.

forest-perimeter-2.name: Forest Perimeter Chest Two
forest-perimeter-2.description: Discover the chest deep within the outskirts of the Xing Dou Forest, near the spider nest.

guardian.name: Guardian Chest
guardian.description: Locate the guarded chest in the outskirts of the Xing Dou Forest.

tang-sect-1.name: Tang Sect Chest One
tang-sect-1.description: Use the Purple Demon Eye to locate all the scattered transformed Tang Sect chests on the map.

tang-sect-2.name: Tang Sect Chest Two
tang-sect-2.description: Use the Purple Demon Eye to locate all the scattered hidden Tang Sect chests on the map.

tang-sect-3.name: Tang Sect Chest Three
tang-sect-3.description: Use the Grappling Hook and Xuan Yu Hand to find the remaining Tang Sect chests on the map.

dragonwood-coffer-1.name: Dragonwood Coffer I
dragonwood-coffer-1.description: Gods took the essence of the eastern Dragonwood and formed a divine covenant to protect precious items. Find the covenant stone to unlock it.

dragonwood-coffer-2.name: Dragonwood Coffer II
dragonwood-coffer-2.description: Gods took the essence of the eastern Dragonwood and formed a divine covenant to protect precious items. Find the covenant stone to unlock it.

dragonwood-coffer-3.name: Dragonwood Coffer III
dragonwood-coffer-3.description: Gods took the essence of the eastern Dragonwood and formed a divine covenant to protect precious items. Find the covenant stone to unlock it.

desolate-flame-coffer-1.name: Desolate Flame Coffer I
desolate-flame-coffer-1.description: Gods took the fire of the western Desolate Flame and formed a divine covenant to protect precious items. Find the covenant stone to unlock it.

desolate-flame-coffer-2.name: Desolate Flame Coffer II
desolate-flame-coffer-2.description: Gods took the fire of the western Desolate Flame and formed a divine covenant to protect precious items. Find the covenant stone to unlock it.

desolate-flame-coffer-3.name: Desolate Flame Coffer III
desolate-flame-coffer-3.description: Gods took the fire of the western Desolate Flame and formed a divine covenant to protect precious items. Find the covenant stone to unlock it.

mysterious-frost-coffer-1.name: Mysterious Frost Coffer I
mysterious-frost-coffer-1.description: Gods took the extreme northern Mysterious Frost and formed a divine covenant to protect precious items. Find the covenant stone to unlock it.

xing-dou-perimeter-crystal.name: Xing Dou Perimeter Crystal
xing-dou-perimeter-crystal.description: Find all the scattered Asura God Mind Crystals in the outskirts of the Xing Dou Forest.

teleport-point-of-xing-dou-forest-outski.name: Teleport Point of Xing Dou Forest Outskirts
teleport-point-of-xing-dou-forest-outski.description: Find the teleport point on the outskirts of the Xing Dou Great Forest.
